_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. delivery_method is 'ntfy' (free push notifications), 'twilio' (SMS) or 'email'. Secrets can go in environment variables instead (NTFY_TOPIC, TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER, BRADBURY_TO_NUMBER, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD, BRADBURY_TO_ADDRESS); env vars win over this file.
